title: 第19章 肯定不打脸第20章 任你气势滔天我自一剑破之
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: 杨辰听到李轩的话，顿时不再犹豫，开始点名林家人。
“林浩。”
伴随着他的声音，林浩迈步走出，纵身跃到了擂台之上。
嗖！
李轩根本就没有给他废话机会，一步踏出，转瞬间便是已经逼近林浩，同时一脚踢了出去。
狂暴的灵气炸裂开来，林浩面色大变。
他想要躲避，可却根本就躲不过去。
伴随着咔嚓一声，他胸口骨骼直接被踢碎，嘴里发出一声惨叫，倒飞下了擂台。
看到李轩如此凶悍，现场众人无不变色。
操的。
竟然又是一脚。
这家伙刚才的虚弱究竟是怎么好意思装出来的？
那些林家人看着这一幕，则是全都忍不住死死捏紧了拳头。
耻辱。
这对他们林家来说，绝对是耻辱！
“下一个。”
李轩没有在意那些林家人的眼神，更是没有浪费时间，继续开口。
“林耀。”
又是一名青年很快走出。
这人手持一柄半臂长的弯刀，步伐平稳，眼神极其冷冽。
他乃林家先天境一重后辈中排名第一的妖孽，战力极强。
比之前面的林浩、林宏二人，都要强悍很多。
只不过，此时面对李轩，面对这个低了他一个大境界的家伙，林耀却是并没有往日的自信和从容，有的只是凝重。
他并没有如同前面的林浩和林宏一般，上台就先说废话，也没有先动手，而是鼓动起全身气势，做好了防御准备。
正所谓敌不动我不动，他现在想的并不是强势击败李轩，而是先消耗李轩灵气。
李轩瞥了林耀一眼，眼中浮现出一抹嘲弄之色。
他脚步一错，猛地朝前冲去。
林耀心里咯噔一下，刹那间体内灵气暴走，浑身神经都紧绷了起来。
一道破风之音响起。
李轩左脚点地，身体猛地腾空，紧接着右腿就犹如是钢鞭一般，裹挟着澎湃灵气闪电般踢出。
林耀看到这一幕，瞳孔骤然一缩。
他一声暴吼，手中弯刀猛地一斩，嗡地一声，瞬间便是狠狠斩向了李轩右腿。
“卧槽！”
“不愧是林家先天境一重中的第一人，反应好快！”
content_en:
When Yang Chen heard Li Xuan's words, he immediately stopped hesitating and started naming the Lin family.
"Lin Hao."
Following his voice, Lin Hao stepped out and jumped onto the ring.
"Li Xuan, I——"
Whoosh!
Li Xuan didn't give him a chance to talk nonsense. He took a step forward and in an instant he was approaching Lin Hao and kicked him out at the same time.
The violent spiritual energy exploded, and Lin Hao's expression changed drastically.
He wanted to avoid it, but he couldn't.
With a click, the bones in his chest were kicked to pieces, and he let out a scream and flew down the ring.
Seeing how fierce Li Xuan was, everyone at the scene changed their minds.
Damn it.
It was another kick.
How did this guy have the nerve to pretend to be weak just now?
The Lin family members couldn't help but clenched their fists when they saw this scene.
shame.
This is an absolute shame for the Lin family!
"Next one."
Li Xuan didn't pay attention to the looks of those Lin family members, and he didn't waste time and continued to speak.
"Lin Yao."
Another young man walked out quickly.
This man was holding a half-arm-long scimitar, his steps were steady, and his eyes were extremely cold.
He is the number one monster among the descendants of the Lin family who are in the first level of Xiantian realm, and he has extremely strong combat power.
Much stronger than Lin Hao and Lin Hong before.
However, facing Li Xuan at this time, facing this guy who was a huge level below him, Lin Yao did not have the confidence and calmness of the past, but only solemnity.
Like Lin Hao and Lin Hong before him, he didn't just talk nonsense when he came on stage, nor did he make the first move. Instead, he gathered all his momentum and prepared for defense.
As the saying goes, if the enemy cannot move, I will not move. What he wants now is not to defeat Li Xuan forcefully, but to consume Li Xuan's spiritual energy first.
Li Xuan glanced at Lin Yao, with a mocking look in his eyes.
He made a mistake in his steps and rushed forward suddenly.
Lin Yao's heart skipped a beat. In an instant, spiritual energy surged through his body, and all his nerves became tense.
"Whoosh!"
A sound of breaking wind sounded.
Li Xuan touched the ground with his left foot, and his body suddenly jumped into the air. Then his right leg was like a steel whip, wrapped in surging spiritual energy and kicked out like lightning.
"Kill!"
When Lin Yao saw this scene, his pupils suddenly shrank.
He roared violently and slashed with the scimitar in his hand. With a buzzing sound, he slashed hard at Li Xuan's right leg in an instant.
"Fuck!"
"He is worthy of being the number one person in the first level of the Lin family's Xiantian Realm. He reacts so quickly!"
title_en: Chapter 19: Definitely not a slap in the face Chapter 20: No matter how powerful you are, I will defeat you with one sword
